content.title: Fastest time to run the Boston marathon (female) | Guinness World Records
content.text: Share Facebook Twitter Email Whatsapp Pinterest LinkedIn Reddit Contact an Account Manager Who Sharon Lokedi What 2:17:22 hour(s):minute(s):second(s) Where United States (Boston) When 21 April 2025 The fastest time to run the Boston marathon (female) is 2 hours 17 minutes 22 seconds, achieved by Sharon Lokedi (Kenya) in Boston, Massachusetts, USA, on 21 April 2025. Sharon Lokedi took more than two-and-a-half minutes off the previous women’s course record in Boston. Records change on a daily basis and are not immediately published online.
